snippet.title: Dreadline Express - Gameplay Teaser | Curiosity-driven horror game set aboard the last human train
snippet.description:
Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, curiosity-driven horror game set aboard the last human train.
Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3327120/Dreadline_Express/

Key features:
* Non-linear exploration.
* Unique narrative card mechanics that give you full narrative control.
* Elevated Lovecraftian horror with a strong focus on the atmosphere and immersion.
* No hand-holding; you are encouraged to be clever and creative.

https://dreadline.express/

#indiegame #horror #train #cards
